label: Mammal
description: Mammal subjects for wildlife work — posture and pelage detail an editor would keep.

items.name: lion
items.text: a black-maned lion surveying the grassland from a termite mound, low light turning the mane's fringe into a rim of fire

items.name: snow-leopard
items.text: a snow leopard draped over a rock ledge, meter-long tail wrapped around itself for warmth, rosettes dissolving into the scree behind

items.name: tiger
items.text: a Bengal tiger shoulder-deep in dry elephant grass, stripes breaking its outline until only the white ear spots give it away

items.name: wolf
items.text: a grey wolf paused mid-trot in falling snow, one forepaw curled under, guard hairs frosted, pale eyes steady on the lens

items.name: brown-bear
items.text: a brown bear braced chest-deep at the lip of the rapids, jaws open toward a leaping salmon, spray beading its soaked shoulder hump

items.name: elephant
items.text: a dust-red elephant matriarch leading the herd in single file, trunk raised to test the wind, calves shielded between the cows

items.name: red-fox
items.text: a winter-coated red fox with a snow-dusted muzzle, black-stockinged legs, brush tail flagged with its white tip

items.name: mountain-gorilla
items.text: a silverback mountain gorilla hunched in dripping foliage, rain running off the silver saddle across his back, knuckles planted wide

items.name: red-deer-stag
items.text: a red deer stag roaring in the autumn rut, neck swollen and mane matted, breath pluming into the mist

items.name: bison
items.text: a frost-caked bison sweeping snow aside with sideways swings of its massive head, exhaling steam, hump ridged with rime

items.name: cheetah
items.text: a cheetah at full stretch mid-gallop, all four feet airborne, tail flung wide as a counterweight to the turn

items.name: giraffe
items.text: a giraffe silhouetted beside a lone flat-topped acacia, neck and legs echoing the tree's own branching lines

items.name: orangutan
items.text: an orangutan mother bridging a canopy gap with her own body while her infant crosses along her back

items.name: arctic-hare
items.text: an arctic hare bolt upright on packed snow, forepaws tucked to its chest, all white except the black ear tips

items.name: wild-horse
items.text: wild horses running through shallow surf, spray exploding at their knees, manes and tails streaming into one line of motion

items.name: hedgehog
items.text: a hedgehog plowing nose-first through autumn leaf litter, a skewered leaf riding on its dew-tipped spines

items.name: leopard
items.text: a leopard draped along a fever-tree limb, one forepaw and tail hanging vertical, its hoisted impala kill wedged in the fork above

items.name: polar-bear
items.text: a polar bear lying flat on sea ice beside a seal breathing hole, utterly still, black nose the only break in the white

items.name: meerkat-sentinel
items.text: a meerkat sentinel upright on a termite mound, dark eye patches cutting the glare, head snapping between sky and horizon

items.name: alpine-ibex
items.text: an alpine ibex poised on a ledge no wider than its hooves, scimitar horns ridged with annual growth rings, cliff dropping away below

items.name: musk-ox-ring
items.text: musk oxen shoulder to shoulder in a defensive ring, calves hidden inside, ground blizzard streaming through their skirted guard hair

items.name: red-kangaroo
items.text: a red kangaroo at full bound, body horizontal and thick tail curved as a counterbalance, heat shimmer rising off the red plain

items.name: sea-otter
items.text: a sea otter floating on its back in a kelp bed, cracking a clam against the flat anvil stone balanced on its chest, a kelp frond wrapped around its middle as an anchor

items.name: pangolin
items.text: a pangolin walking upright on its hind legs across red laterite earth, foreclaws curled to its chest, overlapping keratin scales shifting like roof tiles at every step

items.name: three-toed-sloth
items.text: a three-toed sloth hanging by all four hook claws beneath a cecropia branch, green algae tinting its grooved fur, one deliberate limb moving at a time

items.name: hippo-gape
items.text: a hippo threat-gaping at the waterline, jaw hinged open past ninety degrees, tusks bared, water streaming off its ears as it rears from the pool

items.name: bat-emergence
items.text: free-tailed bats unwinding from a cave mouth in a smoke-like column at dusk, the spiral shearing downwind, a hawk cutting through the stream

items.name: moose-feeding
items.text: a bull moose surfacing from a beaver pond with waterweed draped across his antlers, sheets of water pouring off the velvet-covered summer palms
